title: I have a really weird crash issue, BlockBench to Godot Forward+
body:
### Tested versions

Godot 4.6.2 Stable Standard
BlockBench 5.1.3

I copied the files over into a clean game folder.
In Godot 4.6.0 Stable Standard it still happens.
In Godot 4.5.0 Stable Standard There is no issue.

### System information

Laptop with i7-8650U, 128mb graphics, 16gb ram

### Issue description

If I use the Forward+ Renderer in Godot with embedded textures Godot freezes and crashes with no generated Logs.

 If I am not in Forward++. Mobile and Compatibility mode import the meshes fine with textures embedded no issue.

### Steps to reproduce

I have a scene of 7 objects with the basic generated Blockbench texture, the scene is 621 faces in all. I've tested it with both the GLTF export options and the FBX export option.

If I use the Forward+ Renderer in Godot with embedded textures, the moment I bring the assets into a scene, or if I open the scene itself and try and move around it. Godot freezes and crashes with no generated Logs.

If I bring those same files into Forward++ without embedded textures I can drag and drop the exported png texture on the individual texture, the UV's and colors are imported correctly, and I can move about the scene with no problems whatsoever.

An added wrinkle. If I am not in Forward++. Mobile and Compatibility mode import the meshes fine with textures embedded no issue.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[45_blockbenchImport_test - Copy.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26857119/45_blockbenchImport_test.-.Copy.zip)
[46_blockbenchimport_test - Copy.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26857120/46_blockbenchimport_test.-.Copy.zip)
